scope_change_note: Rescoped from a dual-model (A+B) planning package to a single-model proof-of-concept. Model A (Subspace KNN) and the old GAP-derived golden vectors were removed entirely from this firmware repo on 2026-07-14 (not relocated here - see 'excluded_from_scope' for where the historical record now lives). This also simplifies Stage 6C: no on-device KNN / RAM-streaming implementation is needed, only the single Coarse Tree.

firmware_repo_only_files.note: These two files are not part of the base export package (they don't exist in the trainer repo's exports/esp32_port/) - they were copied separately from the trainer repo's src/weldmltrainer/ as formula reference material for Q10 (FSJ column -> feature mapping) and remain valid; feature formulas are unaffected by the model-selection rescoping.

excluded_from_scope.note: Model A (Subspace KNN) artifacts and the GAP evaluation preview are NOT present in this firmware repo as of 2026-07-14. The historical record (why Model A and the dual-model cascade were evaluated and rejected) lives in the trainer repo only: WeldMLTrainer-PyTorch/docs/reports/model_a_gap100_subspace_knn/ and WeldMLTrainer-PyTorch/docs/reports/GAP_SPOSM_GE_ZERO_EVALUATION_PREVIEW.md.

missing_or_uncertain_items: Exact physical units are partly inferred from feature names/source logs; verify against feature_extraction.py and original sensor documentation before firmware release.

No GAP-distribution evaluation is included in this package by design; the model is not claimed to generalize beyond the original38 training distribution (see docs/reports/MODEL_SELECTION_DECISION_CURRENT.md).
golden_vectors.json reports two distinct accuracy figures (94.7% LOOCV vs. 100% deployed-artifact resubstitution) - do not conflate them; see golden_vectors.json's accuracy_note field.
